60/G.goal: Use Unity to move from theoretical XR concepts to implementation by setting up the Unity environment and using its core editor concepts to create and preview an XR scene.
60/G.achieves: It serves the course aim of implementing an XR system with confidence by providing the foundational development-environment skills needed before detailed case-study implementation and optimization.

60/O1.goal: Set up and use Unity to begin implementing an XR system by installing and managing Unity, understanding its cross-platform abstraction of the graphics pipeline, and applying its editor views, XR settings, assets, scenes, game objects, and prefabs to create and preview an XR scene.
60/O1.achieves: It gives the learner a practical Unity workflow and core terminology for moving from XR theory to scene-based implementation in the course case study.
